The prize money on "100X Merry MONEY" leans toward many smaller prizes. It is spread over eleven prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $2 million. Games built like this pay small prizes often and large prizes rarely. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

For "100X Merry MONEY" or any game, being late in a run is not automatically good or bad. The same numbers mean different things near the end of a run.

The numbers for "100X Merry MONEY" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1918.headline: How this game pays out

1919.body:
"QUICK WINS" is still new, with nearly all of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

Everything above about "QUICK WINS" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1919.headline: Early stage or late

1921.body:
"$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" is about halfway through its run, with about two-thirds of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1921.headline: Where this game is in its run

1927.body:
"CASH SCRATCH FEVER" is new from the Georgia Lottery. It is a $5 game with three top prizes of $400,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything above about "CASH SCRATCH FEVER" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1927.headline: New game, all prizes left

1929.body:
"Cheers 2027" has joined the Georgia lineup at $3 with seventeen top prizes of $20,027. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Everything here about "Cheers 2027" comes from official Georgia lottery numbers, current through November 18.
1929.headline: A brand-new game to watch
